## 9. Recommended Codex work plan (priority order)

**Working assumptions for Codex:** repo `Ejgood21/gaming-hub`, new home `apps/tft/` (mirroring `apps/wow/`), file split out of the single HTML (see P0.3). Model: GPT 6.1 Sol Extra High for Codex sessions (per standing rule). No paid services. All changes must keep the file working as a standalone page (the user opens a single HTML file today) unless Evan approves a build step.

### P0 — Test harness + data model (do first; everything else depends on it)

1. **Extract the pure modules and add Node tests.** `Tracker` and `PivotPlanner` already have `module.exports` guards (lines 461, 721) — extend the pattern to `Academy` (pure parts: `decodeCode`, `unpack`, `normalize`, `cleanGuide`, `build`, `priorities`), `MetaBuilds.compact`, `CompFinder` (evaluate/ranked/componentFit), `DecisionPlanner` (builds/solve/carousel/anvil), `AugmentAdvisor`, `LootTracker`. No DOM at import time. Add `apps/tft/test/*.test.js` run by `node --test` with **zero dependencies**. Gate: the acceptance cases in §9.4 pass.
2. **Snapshot layer.** Replace the three inline blobs with versioned snapshot files the app loads in order: `data/academy-<patch>.json`, `data/metatft-<patch>.json`, `data/openers-<patch>.json`, `data/core-items.json` (the current `DATA`). Each carries `{patch, set, source, sourceUpdated, curatedAt, schemaVersion}`. The HTML keeps a *minimal* bundled fallback (last known good) and the UI always shows patch + source date per source (Academy already does; extend to MetaTFT and openers). Add a freshness check: if `Academy.patch !== MetaTFT.patch`, banner + demote Meta bonuses (§3.8 B3); if opener patch mismatches, opener display-only (§8.2.5).
3. **Split the file, keep the standalone build.** Move CSS/JS/data into `apps/tft/` source files with a tiny build script that produces the single-file `carousel-companion.html` for distribution (inlining only small assets; see P3.1). This is a precondition for tests and for anyone else editing the code — 2,335 lines with 4.9 MB lines is unmaintainable as-is.

### P0 — Correctness fixes (recommender)

4. **Fix the S/A claim and the empty state.** (a) If the Academy snapshot has no S guides, the UI must say so ("No S-tier comp in this snapshot — top band is A") instead of implying S exists. (b) With no meaningful input (fitScore 0 across the board / fewer than 2 signals), show "Not enough to recommend yet — add units/items/augment" and list the *opener* guidance (§8) instead of an alphabetical A-tier #1. (c) Unify X-tier: one mapping used by `tierRank`, `tierScore` and `QuickImport` (recommend: X = conditional — rank as B for sorting, display "Situational", never promote an X comp above A on fit alone). Fixes B1, B2, §3.7.1–2.
5. **Gate MetaTFT by patch and surface its relativity.** Check `data.patch` against Academy patch wherever `set` is checked today; on mismatch use bundled/cache only with a visible "stale patch" tag. In the reference dialog, add one line: "S/A are relative within this champion (top builds rescaled)". Fixes B3, §2.2.
6. **Make emblem/augment gating data, not prose.** Replace the `/only play…emblem/` regex (line 1435) with an explicit `gatedBy` field on the guide snapshot (`{type:'emblem'|'augment', id}`), populated at snapshot-curation time from the guide data (Academy already supplies `mainAugment` and emblem items — use them). Same for `itemizationOrder`'s prose regex: prefer the guide's structured `carousel`/priority data; drop the regex or keep it only as a fallback with a logged warning. Fixes B6.
7. **Fix special-item pivots.** Extend `PivotPlanner.roles` to cover Academy item types (emblem by trait, radiant by base item's roles, artifact by its Academy `recommendedChampions`/description tags) or, better, derive roles from the Academy item data at `register()` time so new items get tags automatically. Add `missingRole` and `alreadyPlanned` to the candidate score (they are computed and discarded today, lines 702–703). Fixes B4.

### P1 — Carousel / drop odds (honesty + a real model, or remove the claim)

8. **Decide and implement one of:** (a) *Honest heuristic (recommended for v1):* rename the UI to "Carousel priority — by crafting value" and keep the beam-search gain + loot tie-break, with the existing disclaimers promoted from footnotes into the panel header; **or** (b) *A stated prior model:* add a `carouselOdds` table to the snapshot (per-stage component appearance prior, sourced from community data with a citation and a confidence label) and show "expected value" as gain × prior, clearly labelled as a prior, not a measured odd. Do **not** ship a percentage that implies measured drop rates — no such public dataset is cited anywhere in the file. Add carousel-round input (which carousel: 1st/2nd/…) so the ranking can know how many picks remain.
9. **Fix the backup-size bug (B8):** strip base64 icons from the exported Academy snapshot (export the *cleaned* snapshot, as `normalize` produces) and verify an export-before-refresh round-trips under the 5 MB import cap. Add TTL + set check to the Academy cache load (B9).

### P1 — Pivots and augments

10. **Add a comp-level pivot.** When the active comp's fit drops (e.g. a required emblem/augment is missed, or two core items are replaced by Meta pivots), offer "Pivot comp" — re-run `CompFinder.ranked` *with completed items as sunk costs* (they already are, via `evaluate`) and show the top 2 alternatives **with a delta** ("keeps 3/5 of your completed items, needs Sword+Rod"). This is the missing half of §6.4.
11. **Augment advisor v2 (bounded):** add MetaTFT augment *frequencies* only if a defensible source is available; otherwise keep the Academy+regex engine but (a) calibrate the 38/8/+16/32 thresholds against a labelled set of past decisions (add the labelled cases as tests), (b) add reroll-count input and stage-aware wording, (c) show the top reason *and* the strongest counter-reason. Do not present regex matches as statistics.

### P2 — BunnyMuffins opener (§8)

12. **Ship `openers/18.3b.json` + `OpenerAdvisor` + opener panel** per §8.2, including the explicit comp map, streak input, slam/hold guidance, and the patch-mismatch banner. Acceptance: the §9.4 opener cases.
13. **Wire the opener into carousel-discovery and anvil-components** (Sword/Rod/Belt + slam order when there is no queue), so the three advisors agree.

### P3 — Performance, storage, mobile

14. **Shrink the file:** replace bundled base64 icons with remote URLs + `loading="lazy"` (the live snapshot already does this) or a small local sprite; keep base64 only for the 10 components + 39 core items if offline-first matters. Target: single-file build < 1.5 MB. Defer MetaTFT bundled data: ship only top S/A builds per unit (or fetch on demand) instead of all 15,550 builds.
15. **Storage:** cap the MetaTFT cache (e.g. most-recent 20 units), handle quota errors with a visible warning, and add a "Clear cached data" control.
16. **In-game mode:** a compact portrait layout (queue + carousel + opener only, large tap targets, sticky carousel panel) for phone-beside-game use; keep the full desktop layout as-is.

### 9.4 Acceptance checks (must pass before merge)

Run these as Node tests against the extracted modules (§P0.1), using the **bundled 18.3b snapshot** as fixture data. Where a case depends on a live value (Meta games/avg), pin the fixture value in the test — do not assert against live data.

| # | Input (fixture: bundled 18.3b) | Expected |
|---|---|---|
| A1 | Empty plan (no units/items/components/augment) | No comp presented as a recommendation; UI state is "not enough info" + opener guidance. (Today: alphabetical A-tier #1.) |
| A2 | Completed Guinsoo's Rageblade + Caitlyn 2★ (+ no other items) | Caitlyn Hunters (B, mainItem Radiant Guinsoo's) ranks above other B comps and above A comps it does not fit *only if* the promotion gates pass; at minimum it is the top B comp and its fit explanation cites Guinsoo's + Caitlyn. (BunnyMuffins reroll-check: Guinsoo's + Caitlyn.) |
| A3 | Inferno emblem **not** owned, no Inferno units | Inferno Fast 9 is `blocked` (tip: "Only play with Inferno emblem") and never in the top 3. |
| A4 | Inferno emblem owned + Lux 1★ | Inferno Fast 9 is unblocked and its `missingEmblems` is empty. |
| A5 | Completed Radiant Guinsoo's Rageblade, no normal Guinsoo's | Counts as Guinsoo's for Caitlyn Hunters (`itemMatches` via `baseItem`); does not count as a separate second item. |
| A6 | Diana equipped HoJ + Ionic Spark + Jeweled Gauntlet (bundled Meta S build, 5,260 games, avg 3.60) | `PlanAdvisor`/`MetaBuilds` surface that exact S build as the remaining-build target for Diana; no Academy deviation is suggested for Diana. |
| A7 | Thief's Gloves completed on a champion | Occupies 3 slots: no further item can be placed on that champion (`slotCost` 3); `specialCarrier`/`builds` respect it. |
| A8 | Queue needs Sword for 2 items, Bow for 1; owned: none; no pins | Carousel ranks Sword above Bow (count-first sort), and `gain` for Sword ≥ gain for Bow. |
| A9 | Component anvil offers: Sword + Rod, queue needs both, Sword needed by 2 items | Component-anvil ranking puts Sword first with reason citing count; taking Sword records source `'other'`, not a PvE drop. |
| A10 | Augment offers at 2-1: an Academy-featured augment for the active comp vs two unlisted augments | Advisor action is Take on the featured augment (score ≥ 38, evidence ≥ 2); the unlisted augments show "Limited evidence", not a negative score. |
| A11 | Opener: Invoker emblem owned (no other direction) | Opener fires `emblem-invoker` → Ahri Morgana hard-force; CompFinder bonus applies; opener panel names the rule and source. |
| A12 | Opener: 8+ win streak, no emblem, Sword+Rod owned | Opener direction is Fast 9 (Dragon/Ashe/Draven); carousel discovery prefers Sword/Rod/Belt over other components. |
| A13 | Opener: Guinsoo's + Caitlyn 2★ (same input as A2) | Opener fires `reroll-caitlyn` and agrees with the CompFinder top pick (no opener/comp disagreement). |
| A14 | Academy snapshot patch 18.3b + MetaTFT snapshot patch 18.3 (bundled pair) | MetaTFT builds are tagged stale-patch and do not drive pivots, **or** the pair is re-bundled to matching patches — one of the two, visibly. (Today: silently used.) |
| A15 | Backup exported before any live refresh, then imported | Round-trips successfully (file < 5 MB import cap). (Today: likely fails, B8.) |
| A16 | Live Academy fetch returns a changed `__data.json` shape | App keeps working on the bundled snapshot with a visible "saved data" notice; no blank screen, no exception surfacing to the user. |

### 9.5 What Codex should *not* do in this round

- Do not add an LLM call, a backend, accounts, or a paid API. The no-AI constraint is architectural (§8.2).
- Do not "fix" the recommender by adding a second opaque score. Every new point value needs a reason string (the codebase already does this for augments — extend the pattern to comp fit).
- Do not scrape BunnyMuffins at runtime. Curated snapshot only (§8.2.1).
- Do not change the Academy/MetaTFT endpoints without checking CORS from both `file://` and `https://` — the current direct-fetch design is the thing that breaks most quietly.
